name: Alert
description: Communicates contextual information with a semantic status.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Controls the alert dimensions and content layout.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Sets the description shown by large alerts.

slots.description: Rich description content that takes precedence over the description attribute.

slots.name: action
slots.description: Actions displayed beside or below the title.

events.name: noora-dismiss
events.description: Emitted after the alert is dismissed.

notes: A dismiss action emits a `noora-dismiss` event and hides the element.

examples.title: Types
examples.description: Use primary alerts by default and secondary alerts for lower emphasis.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert type="primary" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert type="secondary" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Choose a compact, standard, or descriptive layout.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert size="small" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert size="medium" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert size="large" status="error" title="Insert your text here" description="Insert your description here. Description in this case is usually two lines"></noora-alert>

examples.title: Primary statuses
examples.description: Primary alerts support error, information, success, and warning states.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert status="information" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert status="success" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert status="warning" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>

examples.title: Secondary statuses
examples.description: Secondary alerts provide the same semantic states with lower emphasis.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert type="secondary" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert type="secondary" status="information" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert type="secondary" status="success" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert type="secondary" status="warning" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>

examples.title: Dismissible
examples.description: Dismiss controls are available in every alert size.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert dismissible size="small" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert dismissible size="medium" status="error" title="Insert your text here"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert dismissible size="large" status="error" title="Insert your text here" description="Insert your description here. Description in this case is usually two lines"></noora-alert>

examples.title: Actions
examples.description: Place related actions in the action slot for compact or descriptive alerts.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert size="small" status="error" title="Insert your text here">
  <noora-link-button slot="action" size="medium" variant="secondary" underline label="Action"></noora-link-button>
</noora-alert>
<noora-alert size="large" status="error" title="Insert your text here" description="Insert your description here. Description in this case is usually two lines">
  <noora-link-button slot="action" size="large" variant="secondary" underline label="Action"></noora-link-button>
</noora-alert>

examples.title: Edge cases
examples.description: Long content and combined actions preserve the alert layout.
examples.markup:
<noora-alert status="information" title="This is a very long title that might wrap to multiple lines in smaller containers or on mobile devices to test text wrapping behavior"></noora-alert>
<noora-alert size="large" status="warning" title="Important Notice" description="This is a very long description that contains multiple sentences and important information. It should properly wrap and maintain readability even when the content extends beyond the typical two-line description. This helps test the layout behavior with extensive content."></noora-alert>
<noora-alert dismissible size="medium" status="success" title="Operation completed successfully">
  <noora-link-button slot="action" size="medium" variant="secondary" underline label="View Details"></noora-link-button>
  <noora-link-button slot="action" size="medium" variant="secondary" underline label="Dismiss"></noora-link-button>
</noora-alert>

attributes.name: fallback

name: Badge
description: Labels an item with compact status or categorization information.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Provides an accessible name when visible text is unavailable.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Controls whether the badge uses a solid or light fill.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Controls the semantic color. Disabled badges ignore this value.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Controls the badge dimensions and text size.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Uses the disabled presentation regardless of color.

attributes.name: dot
attributes.description: Displays a dot before the label when the icon slot is empty.

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: Hides the label and displays only the icon slot.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Provides fallback text when the default slot is empty.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An icon displayed before the label. It takes precedence over dot.

notes: The browser component uses appearance for the visual style because style is a native element property. The Phoenix component keeps its existing style attribute, and both map to the same contract value.
A slotted icon takes precedence over the generated dot.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: Colors communicate semantic meaning while sharing the same compact shape.
examples.markup:
<noora-badge color="neutral">Neutral</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="destructive">Destructive</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="warning">Warning</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="attention">Attention</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="success">Success</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="information">Information</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="focus">Focus</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="primary">Primary</noora-badge>
<noora-badge color="secondary">Secondary</noora-badge>

examples.title: Appearances and sizes
examples.description: Use a light fill for lower emphasis and choose between small and large sizing.
examples.markup:
<noora-badge appearance="fill" size="small" color="success">Small fill</noora-badge>
<noora-badge appearance="light-fill" size="small" color="success">Small light fill</noora-badge>
<noora-badge appearance="fill" size="large" color="information">Large fill</noora-badge>
<noora-badge appearance="light-fill" size="large" color="information">Large light fill</noora-badge>

examples.title: Icons and states
examples.description: Use a generated dot, provide an icon through its named slot, or apply the disabled presentation.
examples.markup:
<noora-badge dot color="success">Online</noora-badge>

<noora-badge appearance="light-fill" color="warning">
  <svg slot="icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke-width="2"></circle>
    <path d="M12 7v6" stroke-width="2"></path>
    <path d="M12 17h.01" stroke-width="2"></path>
  </svg>
  Needs attention
</noora-badge>

<noora-badge disabled>Disabled</noora-badge>

name: Banner
description: Displays a page-level message with an optional dismiss action.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A custom icon used by primary banners.

events.name: noora-dismiss
events.description: Emitted after the banner is dismissed.

notes: A dismiss action emits a `noora-dismiss` event and hides the element.

examples.title: Statuses
examples.description: Banners support primary, error, success, warning, and information states.
examples.markup:
<noora-banner status="primary" title="Primary status" description="I am a primary banner"></noora-banner>
<noora-banner status="error" title="Error status" description="I am an error banner"></noora-banner>
<noora-banner status="success" title="Success status" description="I am a success banner"></noora-banner>
<noora-banner status="warning" title="Warning status" description="I am a warning banner"></noora-banner>
<noora-banner status="information" title="Information status" description="I am an information banner"></noora-banner>

examples.title: Custom icon
examples.description: Primary banners accept a custom icon through the icon slot.
examples.markup:
<noora-banner status="primary" title="Primary status" description="I am a primary banner with a custom icon">

<noora-banner status="information" title="Banner with longer content" description="This is a banner with much longer descriptive text that demonstrates how the component handles multiple lines of content and text wrapping behavior"></noora-banner>

name: BreadcrumbItem
description: Describes one declarative item inside breadcrumbs.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Sets the label instead of using text content.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Shows an icon before the label.

attributes.name: avatar
attributes.description: Shows an avatar before the label.

attributes.name: badge-label
attributes.description: Shows a badge with this label.

slots.description: The label followed by optional noora-dropdown-item children.

notes: Nested noora-dropdown-item children create the optional breadcrumb menu.

examples.title: Item
examples.description: Describe one level in a breadcrumb path.
examples.markup: <noora-breadcrumb-item href="/projects">Projects</noora-breadcrumb-item>

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows the current location in a navigational hierarchy.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Defines breadcrumbs programmatically when declarative noora-breadcrumb-item children are not used.

events.name: noora-open-change
events.description: Emitted when a breadcrumb menu opens or closes.

events.name: noora-select

name: ButtonDropdown
description: Combines a primary button action with an attached menu.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls whether the menu is open.

attributes.name: close-on-select
attributes.description: Closes the menu after a selection.

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Keeps the menu open after selection.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Aligns the menu to the button.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Defines menu items programmatically when declarative noora-dropdown-item children are not used.

slots.name: icon-left
slots.description: An icon before the main label.

slots.name: icon-right
slots.description: An icon after the main label.

events.name: noora-action
events.description: Emitted when the primary button is activated.

events.name: noora-open-change
events.description: Emitted when the menu opens or closes.

events.name: noora-select
events.type: CustomEvent<{ item: Record<string, unknown>; value: unknown }>

examples.title: Default

name: ButtonGroupItem

attributes.name: label

attributes.name: value

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders the item as a link.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Sets the icon for an icon-only item.

attributes.name: icon-left
attributes.description: Shows an icon before the label.

attributes.name: icon-right
attributes.description: Shows an icon after the label.

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: Uses the icon as the complete item content.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Provides an accessible label for an icon-only item.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Shows the item in its selected state.

name: ButtonGroup
